scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "bun run --filter server dev" "bun run --filter web dev"
scripts.tunnel:run: docker compose up -d --wait db && bun run build && concurrently --kill-others -n build,api,tunnel "bun run --filter web build --watch" "bun run --filter server dev" "node scripts/cloudflared.js tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://127.0.0.1:3001"
